facts.label: JPMorgan Chase & Co. common equity tier 1 capital ratio, projected minimum, severely adverse scenario

claims.text: JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s common equity tier 1 capital ratio was 15.0% actual in 2023:Q4, projected 13.4% at 2026:Q1 ending, and projected minimum 12.5% under the severely adverse scenario, per Table A.17 of the 2024 Federal Reserve Stress Test Results.
